_comment: End-of-life dates per PAN-OS release train, as YYYY-MM-DD.
'standard' is the Standard Support end-of-life date; 'extended' is the
Extended Support date where one is offered, otherwise null. A train past
its standard date is marked EOL in the listings, noting the extended date
if that has not passed yet. Conditions attached to extended support are on
the source page and are not reproduced here.
A train absent from this file, or with a null 'standard' date, is treated
as unknown and is never marked EOL - an unknown date must not be
Review this roughly twice a year, or whenever a new train ships.
